critique: The brilliant elevation of mundane HTML form elements—tilting fieldsets, sliders, and checkboxes—into a surreal, Bauhaus-colored architectural maze achieves a wonderful sense of novelty and structural playfulness. To weave in a stronger cyber-nature fusion, the rigid DOM geometry could be explicitly overgrown with generative organic elements, like algorithmic vines or digital mycelium, rather than relying on disconnected static image placeholders.
